title: Solution for Invoice to Cash Automation
summary: Key Takeaways Manual invoice processing costs $29.83 per invoice and takes 20 days. Automation drops that to $2.00 in under a week. Organizations adopting invoice to cash automation typically save 40-60%, with many investments paying back within months. One consumer goods company recovered $33.4 million with a 34-day resolution time, well below the 90-day industry average. A separate organization cut $1.3 million in annual interest costs by improving cash management through automation. Subscription and SaaS businesses gain the most, since payment friction during recurring billing directly drives churn. Forrester research indicates a positive billing experience can raise customer retention by as much as 92%. Customers leave over frustrating payment processes, not product dissatisfaction. Why Invoice to Cash Automation Matters Working with service businesses and SaaS companies, we’ve seen the same pattern: teams spend entire afternoons chasing misapplied payments, reconciling spreadsheets, following up on overdue invoices. Work that automation handles in seconds. The cost difference is stark. Manual invoice processing requires significant staff hours and extended processing times. Automated systems compress the cycle to a fraction of the time and cost.
